notes.title: New Update - v3.0.5
notes.notes:
Hi guys! How are you today?

Queen of Seas 2 has a new update, check it out!

-=-=-=-=-=-
v3.0.5
-=-=-=-=-=-

- BUG Fixed: Player get stuck when caught by an urchin, sometimes.
- Added cosmetic feature: Player now produce air bubbles when underwater.
- Added cosmetic feature: Fishes from different shapes and sizes swimming on background.

-=-=-=-=-=-


Please, report any other bugs in comments below.
